# gyro_container_environment (Data Source)

A Gyro Containers (ECS) environment (GET /cloud/containers/{id}): Kubernetes namespace, in-cluster service domain and the current egress IPv4 addresses (the addresses your containers reach the internet from - put them on the IP allow list of an external service). Egress IPs change when the environment's nodes change (plan change, node replacement, pool scaling); the owner is notified.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gyro_container_environment" "app" {
  service_id = 12345
}

# Egress IPs: put them on the IP allow list of an external service (database, payment provider, partner API).
# They change when the environment's nodes change; the owner is notified and this list is always current.
output "egress_ips" {
  value = data.gyro_container_environment.app.egress_ips
}

# Other services of the same environment reach a service at <service>.<namespace>.svc.cluster.local:80 (or <service>:80).
output "api_internal_url" {
  value = "http://api.${data.gyro_container_environment.app.service_domain}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (Number) Container environment (service) id.

### Read-Only

- `build_egress_ips` (List of String) Gyro Pipeline build machines (git clone / archive download).
- `code` (String) Environment code (used in <service>-<code>.gyroapp.net).
- `egress_hash` (String) Changes whenever egress_ips change.
- `egress_ips` (List of String) Current egress IPv4 addresses (dedicated: own nodes + the shared pool used during updates; serverless: shared pool nodes). No IPv6.
- `egress_note` (String)
- `host_suffix` (String) Public host suffix, -<code>.gyroapp.net.
- `ingress_ips` (List of String) Inbound address for apex A records of custom domains.
- `mode` (String) dedicated (own node pool) or serverless (shared sandboxed pool).
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace of the environment, e.g. t-canli-12345.
- `service_domain` (String) In-cluster DNS suffix: services are reached at <service>.<service_domain>:80 (or <service>:80) from the same environment.
- `suspended` (Boolean)
